title: MediFund
tagline: A crowfunding App on which you can fund people who need medical help
description: MediFund is a crowdfunding platform designed to connect individuals in need of medical assistance with donors willing to contribute to their healthcare expenses. It serves as a bridge between those facing medical emergencies or chronic illnesses and compassionate individuals who want to make a difference.
how_its_made: With Open XMTP frames and MediFund Frames, sponsor individuals' medical bills seamlessly. Empower those in need by facilitating direct donations for medical expenses. Utilize transparent transactions to ensure every contribution makes a tangible impact. Join the MediFund community today and make a difference in someone's healthcare journey.
